title: mail-server: check_email_push_change for create/update to call (no hook), emailPush/{accountId}/... invalidProperties paths, normalization, objectHistory accept-and-drop
description:
Design: docs/design/emailpush.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: E6. Crates: jmap-mail-server. Size: M.

Spec: draft-ietf-jmap-emailpush-05 §4 invalidProperties rules (1)-(5) and "MUST include the path to each invalid value" (emailPush/{accountId}, .../filter, .../properties, .../urgency), the §4 filter/properties/urgency requirements; RFC 8620 §5.3; object-history-03 §3.1. Design: docs/design/emailpush.md §5.2, §4 "Normalized form"; decisions 9, 10 and 16 in docs/design/DECISIONS.md.

Implement pub async fn check_email_push_change<B: EmailPushBackend>(backend: &B, caller, old: Option<&PushSubscription>, new: &mut PushSubscription) -> Result<(), BackendSetError<B::Error>> in emailpush/validate.rs. There is no check_push_subscription_change hook (decision 16): the deployment's create_push_subscription (old None) and update_push_subscription (old = stored, new = patched) MUST call it before storing, as chat backends call validate_chat_push; the rustdoc says MUST. No side effects. The change includes emailPush when new has the key on create, or old and new differ in emailPush on update; otherwise only rule (5) runs (the account check runs only when the change touches emailPush). Otherwise: a non-object value => path emailPush; rule 5: non-null and keys None => add "keys"; load email_push_accounts once; for each key A: unknown account or non-object config => emailPush/A; filter must decode as Option<EmailFilter>, stay within jmap_server::MAX_FILTER_DEPTH (filter_nests_deeper_than) and use only supported conditions (mail: every EmailCondition; non-mail: the 10 required + inMailbox* when object_ids + filter_conditions; metadata conditions also need metadata_info::<Email>(caller, A); create/update receive no using, so there is no metadata-in-using gate, decision 16) else emailPush/A/filter; properties must decode as Vec<String> and each pass project::check_email_property (bodyValues always fails; non-mail: the 8-name minimum + id/threadId/mailboxIds when object_ids + declared extras; objectHistory passes only when mail && email_history, decision 10) else emailPush/A/properties; urgency must decode as Urgency else emailPush/A/urgency. Collect every bad path: one SetError invalidProperties ["emailPush", paths in map order, "keys" for rule 5]. On success rewrite extra["emailPush"] as the normalized BTreeMap<Id, EmailPushConfig> (defaults filled, decision 9), with every objectHistory removed from properties and the other names kept in order (decision 10). E1's generic echo returns it in created/updated (decision 16). Factor the per-config checks that need no backend call (decode, depth, conditions and properties allowed for an EmailPushAccount) into pub fn check_email_push_config, shared with delivery (E8 skips configs that fail it, decision 16).
Acceptance (one test per path): the §5 request accepted for mail:false, object_ids:true; unknown account => ["emailPush","emailPush/X"]; "A": null => emailPush/A; {"foo":1} filter => .../filter; inMailbox with neither mail nor ObjectID => .../filter; bodyValues, and id without mail/ObjectID => .../properties; "urgent" => .../urgency; keys null => ["emailPush","keys"]; two bad accounts => both paths; a filter 33 deep => .../filter; header:Subject:asText accepted for mail and rejected for an undeclared non-mail account; a metadata condition on an account without metadata_info => .../filter; {"A":{}} normalizes to {"A":{"filter":null,"properties":[],"urgency":"normal"}}; ["from","objectHistory","subject"] with mail+email_history is stored as ["from","subject"], and with email_history false or mail false => .../properties; an update whose emailPush equals the stored one passes with a stale account; a deployment-style mock whose create/update call the function rejects and normalizes through PushSubscription/set end to end.
notes:
2026-11-13: refiled from docs/design/emailpush.md (note key E6).
2026-11-13: updated for decision 16
2026-11-13: decision 26: metadata filter conditions in emailPush need only metadata_info::<Email> for the account, not the metadata URI in using; rustdoc says why (metadata-05 no-using rules cover Foo/set writes, Foo/get defaults, Foo/changes; the filter runs at delivery outside any request).
2026-11-13 OPEN for Mark (docs/design/emailpush.md §12 Q1): accept objectHistory in EmailPushConfig.properties only where this deployment's Email/get accepts it (mail && email_history) and reject elsewhere as unsupported (recommended; literal reading of decision 10), or accept on every account. Implement the recommended gated reading unless Mark says otherwise.
